newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Shanghai Industrial signs US$135 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Shanghai Industrial signs US$135 mln loan.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holding) Ltd has signed a US$135 million term loan facility, the borrower said on Friday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years.
Proceeds are to be used for financing investments in Shanghai.

Participating banks are Sanwa Bank, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Hong Kong, Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank Hong Kong, Fuji Bank, Long Term Credit Bank of Japan, Sakura Bank, Toyo Trust and Banking Co Hong Kong, WestLB and Yasuda Trust and Banking Co. --Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4039
